in_marathi.name: Nimesha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Recall, Remember, Contemplate
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nimesha is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'nim' which means to recall, remember or contemplate. It is a divine name associated with the Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. The name Nimesha signifies the act of deep contemplation and introspection, encouraging one to recall and remember the spiritual teachings and wisdom passed down through generations.
